meta.themes: Frontier Models Broaden Access, AI Platforms Consolidate, Data Center Supply Chains Shift, Agent Workflows Gain Operational Controls

news.title: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 for difficult technical work
news.summary: Anthropic said the models improve coding, reasoning, and vision, generate up to 30% faster than version 5.1, and add a faster optional mode.

news.title: GitHub added Gemini 4 Hydrogen to Copilot
news.summary: GitHub made Google's fast agentic model generally available across Copilot plans and surfaces, including coding agent, CLI, IDEs, mobile, and the Copilot SDK.

news.title: Google released A2UI 1.0 for native agent interfaces
news.summary: A2UI 1.0 gives agents an open protocol for interactive screens, with renderer SDKs for web and mobile plus agent SDKs for Python, TypeScript, and Dart.

news.title: Anthropic launched the roadshow for its proposed IPO
news.summary: Anthropic began the roadshow for a proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock after filing its registration statement in October.

news.title: OpenAI and Upwork found AI freelance projects carry broader scopes and larger budgets
news.summary: Their research found AI-related postings combined more diverse tasks and involved larger fixed-price budgets and more work hours than other freelance projects.

news.title: Cohere expanded its sovereign AI platform with AISLE and cubic
news.summary: Cohere completed its AISLE acquisition, formed Cohere Cyber, and added cubic's code-review team to build secure coding tools for controlled deployments.

news.title: Meta signed long-term deals for lower-carbon data center supply chains
news.summary: Meta committed to low-carbon cement, near-zero-emission steel, electric trucking, and recycled plastics to scale cleaner data center construction inputs.

news.title: AWS brought SGLang serving and reinforcement-learning rollouts to Trainium
news.summary: SGLang-Neuron is now public through an AWS Deep Learning Container, using native PyTorch to serve frontier models and generate training rollouts on Trainium.

news.title: U.S. officials pressed for tighter controls on Nvidia chip exports
news.summary: AP reported that Treasury, State, Defense, and the U.S. Trade Representative backed adding Megaspeed to an export-control list while Commerce delayed action.

news.title: n8n Labs released Nod as an open-source personal computer agent
news.summary: Nod runs locally on Mac and Windows, works across apps and websites, asks before acting, and supports user-selected cloud or open-source models.

news.title: Visual Studio Code 1.146 added an inbox for agent sessions
news.summary: The stable release added experimental inbox grouping, model comparison, separate chat windows, agent-window extensions, and a path off the local harness.

news.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore added a direct Web Search API
news.summary: The API returns ranked current-web results through one IAM-signed call, without a gateway or setup resources, and supports domain and publication-date filters.
